verdict.rationale: Bland is an API-driven voice platform, so publishing an OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack shows no downloadable machine-readable spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. llms.txt is a documentation index and the 'Pathways API reference' is human-readable docs; neither is an API spec, and MCP/CLI tooling is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
